channel.title: Boolean Build
channel.description: Notes on shipping Expo & React Native apps — release engineering, CI, and build gates.

item.title: “Multiple consecutive ads”: designing ad frequency that survives App Review
item.description: App Review rejects apps that show back-to-back interstitials. The call-site pattern that causes it, a testable frequency policy, and how to explain the change in your reply.

item.title: Your app crashes on launch in iOS 27 because it never adopted UIScene
item.description: EXC_BREAKPOINT in UIApplicationEvaluateRuntimeIssueForNoSceneLifecycleAdoption — why builds compiled with the iOS 27 SDK die before JavaScript runs, and how to fix it in Expo.

item.title: Choosing an Expo / React Native starter template: a buyer's checklist
item.description: What to check before you buy or adopt a starter template — strict typecheck, real screens, a release path, licence terms — plus a 10-minute evaluation that separates a kit from a demo.

item.title: Store screenshots get rejected for geometry — the 2:1 trap and the accepted sizes
item.description: Why raw phone captures fail Google Play's 2:1 screenshot limit, the App Store's native sizes, and how to gate both in CI.

item.title: The Android manifest mistakes that get Play builds rejected
item.description: android:exported, debuggable, cleartext, allowBackup, targetSdkVersion and permissions — the six manifest attributes that sink Play submissions, and how to check them before you upload.

item.title: Versioning an Expo app: version vs buildNumber vs versionCode
item.description: What each number does, when to bump it, and the CI trick that avoids “build number already used”.

item.title: The app icon rules that get apps rejected (iOS + Android)
item.description: iOS alpha channels, Android adaptive safe zones, and the splash-icon-vs-app-icon trap that gets apps flagged as misleading.

item.title: Before you upload: the app-store rejection checklist
item.description: The recurring reasons App Store and Google Play reject submissions — and how to check each one before you upload.

item.title: Add CI to an Expo app in 10 minutes (GitHub Actions)
item.description: A fast GitHub Actions pipeline for Expo/React Native — lint, typecheck, and Jest on every PR, no simulator required.

item.title: Ship an Expo app to TestFlight without EAS
item.description: The local Xcode pipeline for archiving and uploading an iOS build to TestFlight — no EAS — and the gotchas that cost the most time.

item.title: Fixing the Google Play "16 KB page size" rejection
item.description: Why your React Native app gets rejected on Android 15+, how to check it, and the fix that actually works.

item.title: Two build gates that make RN quality non-negotiable
item.description: A screens gate and an acceptance-contract gate that fail your React Native build instead of shipping bugs.
